summary: Closed all 10 leaves in synteq-umbau/plaetze. Five SQLite DBs are integrity-ok and each SQL dump reconstructs the exact logical state. Historical design used immutable versioned baustein rows plus separate usage history; A1 preserves numeric UI acceptance style, A2 preserves deterministic bounded external-generation contracts. Negative result: Chef usage history contains an orphan schrift v2 reference because usage rows have no referential-integrity gate. Jasmin/Shed payloads and dumps are exact duplicates with distinct place identities.

unifieddb: versioned immutable objects + usage history reusable
claycode: represent immutable version identities + usage receipts
claygraph: usage/activation edge never proves target existence/authority
